rules.statement: A person who has seized property under a writ is not a necessary party to a mortgage action and cannot intervene under the Civil Procedure Code or the Mortgage Ordinance.
rules.supporting_quote: Held , that the petitioner was not entitled to intervene as he was not a necessary party for the adjudication of the questions involved in the action between the plaintiff and the defendant. Held further, that he was not a necessary party within the meaning of section 6 (1) of the Mortgage Ordinance.
